pages.title: Diet Screen
pages.text: The full diet screen shows detailed breakdowns of every food group and your recent eating history.

pages.title: Reading the Screen
pages.text:
Each food group shows a $(bold)fill bar$() representing your current level. Bars drain over time through nutrient decay.

Hover over a bar to see the exact value, your active bonus or penalty, and which foods you have recently eaten in that group.
